name: e2llm
description: E2LLM connects Claude to your real browser through the E2LLM browser extension. Claude can read the page you are on as a structured representation and act on it — open tabs, click, type — always through per-action permission grants that you approve. Perception happens in your browser, with your logged-in sessions and the sites you already use. Free tier available; Pro adds higher usage limits. Setup takes about two minutes: install the extension, connect your account, done.

_published_faq.name: How do I add e2llm to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add e2llm to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.e2llm.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the e2llm MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: e2llm provides these MCP tools: act, batch_act, close_tab, explore, inspect, list_tabs, query, read_page, and sifr_capture.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to e2llm?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to e2llm in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
e2llm requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
e2llm is developed by insitu.im. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
